description:
Use this when the user wants end-of-day prices or ratios for several Indian stocks at once (up to 20), for example to line up peers.

Returns one item per symbol, each with its own `status`; the fields of get_stock_quote are under `quote`. `symbols` takes up to 20 NSE symbols, ISINs or BSE codes. A symbol that is not found is reported in its own item and does not fail the call. For a table comparing similar companies use get_peer_comparison.

symbols.description: List of up to 20 NSE symbols, ISINs or BSE codes, e.g. ["TCS", "INFY"]. Always send it as `symbols`.
symbols.title: Symbols
